errors.evidence: The chart shows 13 categories on the x-axis, but the description states there are 14.

errors.text_span: 排列顺序未按数值大小排序
errors.evidence: The bars are clearly sorted in descending order of their values from left to right. The description incorrectly states they are not sorted by value, although it later contradicts this by mentioning a decreasing trend.
The y-axis does not have any units explicitly written. The description adds the unit '次数' (count/times), which is an assumption not directly supported by the visual information on the axis.

errors.text_span: “解除质押”事件频次集中在130至150区间
errors.evidence: The description groups several categories into the 130-150 range. However, the bar for '解除质押' (Release of pledge) has a value of approximately 118, which is well outside this stated range.
